full_page.content:
1946, January 12
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo Copy of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y.
January 12th
Mrs. Verna 0'Neill 4827 Edmonton Ave. Detroit, Mich.
Dear Mrs. O'Neill:
God bless you and yours. I hope this finds things brighter and improving with you. Only To- night did I get to open and note your favor of the 8th.
I have enrolled your father and yourself. I hope for the best and that you may experience a de- cidedly surprize.
God bless you all again
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Original in Pos- session of : Mrs. Verna O'Neill 4547 Laurel Club Drive W. Bloomfield, Mich. 48033
